name: Ninshin Injuu Shoujo  Rei
source:
A visual novel about a shrine maiden facing down a sex demon!

It is the first day of summer vacation, and I have taken a part-time job at the local shinto shrine.
Tsubomi told me that the shrine is used to seal away people who have been possessed by sex monsters, and who have turned into sex monsters themselves.
And to return those people to their former selves, one needs to go to the "forbidden place"...

[Description from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE031919.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款讲述巫女直面性恶魔的视觉小说！

暑假的第一天，我在当地神社找到一份兼职。蕾告诉我，这座神社用于封印被淫兽附身、并且自己也变成淫兽的人。
而要让那些人恢复原本的模样，就必须前往「禁地」……
